activity_summary: Against the wall you said the gate was open, a cap was in the road, and backs were running north. You said you did not see the middle of it. Then you stopped.

entities.name: William Shakespeare
entities.context: Spoke the three sentences and stopped.

facets.activity: Named the open gate, the cap and the backs

quotes.speaker: william_shakespeare
quotes.text: I did not see the middle of it.
